paths.title: AI for Legal Professionals
paths.tagline: Faster first passes on documents and research - with grounding, confidentiality, and human review built into every workflow.
paths.description: A ladder of 10 hands-on lessons for lawyers and legal professionals using Claude, ChatGPT, and NotebookLM: summarizing and extracting facts from documents with strict grounding, building internal matter summaries, drafting non-final client communications, building document-review checklists, comparing document versions, preparing meeting questions, organizing research in NotebookLM, and building team-wide prompt frameworks and verification protocols for high-stakes work. Every lesson treats AI output as non-final work product requiring attorney review, never legal advice.
